featured_reviews.name: macedonboy
featured_reviews.review_text:
This statue stands in tribute to the Dabbawala, the lunchbox delivery men of India who deliver lunch from restaurants to people's homes and workplaces.

The sculpture is made up of disks to form a structure of a stereotypical Dabbawala carrying a tiffin box in both arms. The sculpture is a fun and wonderful monument to the ordinary man. The statue is close the the famous Haji Ali Mosque and is worth a detour if you can spare 10 minutes.

featured_reviews.name: MILAN ZATAKIA
featured_reviews.review_text: A piece of Mumbai history. The famous dabbawallahs are none other than the lunch tiffin carriers who have an amazing network of delivery men who use the local railway network to deliver hot meals from Customer residences to their offices in every nook and corner of Mumbai. Global universities like Harvard and IIMA have conducted studies on the efficiency of this business model. Prince Charles of England too was very impressed with this operation. It is only befitting for this concept to be honoured with a statue at a strategic junction like haji Ali,  the Gateway to South Mumbai. Truly remarkable.

featured_reviews.name: Pravin Kumar Panjiyar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mumbai's Dabbawalas are world famous for their timely delivery and immaculate service. Their business model even piqued the interest of Harvard Business School compelling professors to study their distinctive business model.

Heck, they have also been honoured by the British royal family!

And now, after decades of ferrying delicious and hygienically cooked food to thousands of Mumbaikars from homes to offices, the Dabbawalas get their very own art installation, in the form of a statue of a Dabbawala, standing tall and proud, readying himself to deliver the tiffin.

The 13-foot long statue, designed of stainless steel discs by Mumbai-based sculptor Valay Shende, was unveiled at Haji Ali on Friday. The installation is part of a private art foundation in partnership with Mumbai's municipal corporation.

featured_reviews.name: Note from Travelam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting the Mumbai Dabbawala collection point near the railway station was one of the most fascinating experiences of my Mumbai trip. Watching thousands of lunch boxes being sorted, grouped, and dispatched with remarkable precision was truly impressive.

Our guide explained the entire system in detail, from the collection of home-cooked meals to the complex sorting process and their timely delivery across the city. What amazed me most was how this world-famous network operates with such efficiency, accuracy, and coordination, largely without the use of advanced technology.

The dedication, discipline, and teamwork of the Dabbawalas are inspiring. Seeing this unique logistics system in action gave me a whole new appreciation for the people who keep Mumbai moving every day. A highly recommended experience for anyone visiting Mumbai and wanting to understand the city’s incredible work culture and spirit.

Welfare of Dabbawalas
Medi Claim Policy
Dabbawalas have to work hard to ensure that the right tiffin box reach the right customer at right time. This job involves working in all weather conditions like high rain, cold and extreme summer. Due to this, the chance of falling sick increases tremendously. In case of high medical and hospitalization bill, the financial condition of Dabbawala is severely affected.

In order to sort out this problem, Dabbawala Enterprises Private Limited offers Rs. 100,000 (1 Lakhs) medi claim policy to Dabbawalas covering their entire family. This ensures that in the unfortunate event of falling sick or hospitalization, the Dabbawalas are financially secured.

Welfare of Dabbawalas
Insurance
The job of collecting and delivering Tiffin Boxes is a highly risky endeavor undertaken by Dabbawala. Every year thousands of people die on the tracks of Mumbai local trains. In the unfortunate incident of accident of Dabbawala, their families have to undergo an extreme financial hardship which devastates them financially.

In order to sort out this problem, Dabbawala Enterprises Private Limited offers RS. 10,00,000 (10 Lakhs) insurance policy to Dabbawalas. This ensures that in the unfortunate event of an accident, the families of Dabbawalas are financially secured.

featured_reviews.name: anjali joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I highly recommend Health Bag Meal tiffin service! I ordered their tiffins for a month during a time when my husband and I were down with chicken gunya, and our cook was on long leave. Health Bag Meal truly was a lifesaver.

The food is hygienic, non-spicy, and absolutely delicious. Everything is delivered right to your doorstep in sealed bags, so there’s no spilling, mixing, or misplacement. The containers are microwave-safe, making it very convenient to reheat.

What impressed me most is the variety in the menu — no dish was repeated over the entire month! They also don’t use baking powder or baking soda, and we had zero digestion issues. The variety of vegetables and dals was particularly commendable.

Mr. Harish Sharma, the owner, is very courteous, always responds promptly and addresses the queries satisfactorily. On request, he provided vegetables without onion and garlic for my parents, and they loved them. On one occasion, there was a small mix-up in the order, but he promptly sent the correct vegetables again at no extra charge — a truly heartwarming gesture.

Overall, Health Bag Meal combines user-friendly, hygiene, and delicious home-style food with excellent customer service. I’ve already recommended them to many and I will continue to do so!

I would really recommend to opt for this tiffin services as in South Bombay you can’t get such a delicious homely cooked food at a quite decent price.

3.Though they have teams but hands on control was wanted as vivek seemed lost (co owner) whenever I raised the issue the concept of we will make it right or refund did not seem existing there the typical answer from vivek was i will inform my team etc...than feeling apologetic about it felt like some charitable service was given which was free of cost -the attitude of professionalism seemed missing only packing food instead papercartrons mentioning indias best tiffin services does not make them the best they need to feel concerned immidiate action is solicited which was absent .

4.overall sometimes the kadi sent was absolutely bland food was stinking on 2-3occasions which had to be thrown away on other occasions rajma was half cooked some vegetables were unrecognisable and for paneer sabzi they do a blanatant mockery only 3small pcs in a 250ml container ???

Overall my verdict if the whole world has closed its door and ure in dire circumstances only then this may be the last option then eat the price they charge and vis a vis food given  (i took customised option) did not meet my expectations my servants back home eat much better than this food hate saying it but its true

For lunch- Before 8pm for  next day lunch (this could be changed to 9am same day)
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi, thank you for your detailed feedback. While we respect your opinion, we would like to clarify several important points to present a complete and accurate picture.

On food freshness — all our meals are prepared fresh with a defined consumption window. This was clearly discussed with you, as lunch was often being consumed quite late (around 3:30 PM), followed by dinner even later (post 10:30–11 PM). When meals are consumed significantly beyond the recommended timeframe, the taste and overall quality can naturally be affected.

On packaging and spillage — we take even a single incident seriously and addressed your concerns each time. However, we observed that the same image of one damaged container has been repeated multiple times, along with a few other instances. While any issue is important, repeatedly presenting the same case does not reflect the overall service across the 8–10 meals that were ordered and delivered.

On delivery — we would like to clarify that no extra delivery charges were applied. The same standard delivery fee is applicable to all customer orders, as we work with third-party delivery partners and incur a fixed cost per delivery. Despite this, we still made multiple adjustments, including changing delivery personnel, based on your feedback.

On service and coordination — throughout your subscription, several small concerns were raised, and we consistently spent time on calls and coordination to address each one. We made continuous efforts from our end to improve your overall experience.

On portion size and paneer quantity — our paneer dishes are priced at ₹50 per serving, within which we maintain a fixed portion size (typically 3–4 pieces). This is aligned with our pricing model. For higher quantity expectations, we had clearly suggested ordering an additional portion.

On portion measurement — our website clearly states portion sizes in terms of container volume (ml), not exact weight, as different dishes vary in density. Despite this, concerns were raised from day one by weighing individual items, which does not reflect how such meals are standardized.

On food quality concerns — whenever feedback was raised (including rajma), it was immediately escalated to our kitchen team. At the same time, we monitor feedback from other customers who received the same meals, and such issues were not widely reported. Nevertheless, we still acted on your feedback.

Regarding the comparison made about food quality — we understand that taste is subjective. However, statements comparing our food in that manner are personal opinions and do not represent the experience of our wider customer base.

We would also like to highlight that despite these concerns, multiple meals were ordered over time, and we remained consistently engaged, making continuous efforts to address feedback and improve your experience.

That said, we acknowledge that we could not meet your expectations, and we regret that. We remain committed to improving our service and maintaining transparency with all our customers.

We wish you the very best.
